description: Na₂LiIrF₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent LiF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent IrF₆ octahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.83 Å. Li is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form LiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent IrF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-F bond lengths are 1.98 Å. Ir is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form IrF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ir-F bond lengths are 2.02 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na, one Li, and one Ir atom.
